title: Y Combinator Companies & Founders Scraper Input

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose whether to extract company profiles, founder profiles, or both.

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Keyword search across company names, one-liners, and descriptions (e.g. 'artificial intelligence', 'compliance'). Leave empty for all.

batches.title: YC Batches
batches.description: Filter by specific YC batches (e.g. ['Winter 2026', 'Summer 2025']). Leave empty for all batches.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Filter by industry (e.g. ['B2B', 'Fintech', 'Healthcare', 'Consumer', 'Industrials', 'Education']). Leave empty for all.

isHiring.title: Only Companies Hiring
isHiring.description: Filter to only companies that currently have open job positions.

topCompanyOnly.title: Only Top YC Companies
topCompanyOnly.description: Filter to only Y Combinator top valued companies (e.g. Airbnb, Stripe, Coinbase, DoorDash).

includeDeepDetails.title: Fetch Deep Details
includeDeepDetails.description: Enrich companies with direct founder LinkedIn and social profiles, founder bios, and company social handles.

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return. For zero-config trial runs, defaults to 50.
